Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleNonOwnerNoAccess: Vehicle: No Access (Overrides All Non-Owner Permissions)
Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleNonOwnerNoAccess_too: Master denial rule for non-owners on a KIPN-claimed vehicle. When enabled, this overrides Open Unlocked Doors, Tow, and Mechanics regardless of their individual settings -- non-owners get no access of any kind: no entry, no driving, no storage access, no door/tow/mechanics interactions. Owners, authorized players, and administrators are unaffected. When disabled, the three individual permissions below apply normally.
Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleNonOwnerNoAccess_hel: Master denial rule for non-owners on a KIPN-claimed vehicle. When enabled, this overrides Open Unlocked Doors, Tow, and Mechanics regardless of their individual settings -- non-owners get no access of any kind: no entry, no driving, no storage access, no door/tow/mechanics interactions. Owners, authorized players, and administrators are unaffected. When disabled, the three individual permissions below apply normally.
Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleAllowNonOwnerOpenUnl: Vehicle: Allow Non-Owner Open Unlocked Doors

Allows non-owners to open and close already-unlocked passenger/trunk doors on a KIPN-claimed vehicle. It never grants permission to unlock or lock doors. The hood remains governed by Mechanics access. Overridden by No Access.

Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleAllowNonOwnerTow_too: Allows non-owners to attach and detach towing connections involving a KIPN-claimed vehicle. It never grants permission to enter, drive, unlock, or perform mechanics on the vehicle. Overridden by No Access.
Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleAllowNonOwnerTow_hel: Allows non-owners to attach and detach towing connections involving a KIPN-claimed vehicle. It never grants permission to enter, drive, unlock, or perform mechanics on the vehicle. Overridden by No Access.
Sandbox_KIPN_VehicleAllowNonOwnerMechani: Allows non-owners to perform mechanical actions (install, remove, and repair parts) on a KIPN-claimed vehicle. This governs the actual mechanic actions, not merely opening the mechanics interface. Does not grant ownership or bypass normal tool/skill/key requirements. Overridden by No Access.
